slots.title: September payrolls: 29,000 vs 90,000 expected
slots.body:
September nonfarm payrolls: about **29,000** jobs added.

Reuters-survey consensus had been near **90,000**.

Coverage tied the miss to questions about whether the Fed’s recent rate increase arrived as labor demand was already cooling.

Overseas, Japan’s Nikkei 225 closed up **2.3%** at **69,880.60** — reports linked the move to softer U.S. hiring and lower odds of further near-term Fed tightening.

U.S. equity benchmarks finished the prior session higher before this week opened:
- $^GSPC +0.7% to 7,722.72
- $^IXIC +1.2% to 27,190.86

What labor print are you tracking next on the calendar?
